project.name: Cairn
project.description_md:
Self-hosted workspace for a developer: planning, dependency graph, Claude Code inside, GitHub, local instances.

- Spec: `PROJECT_BRIEF.md`
- Progress: `docs/PROGRESS.md`, decisions: `docs/DECISIONS.md`
- This plan: `docs/roadmap.json` (`python manage.py roadmap`). Estimates are rough.
project.claude_instructions_md:
- Read `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/PROGRESS.md` and `docs/DECISIONS.md` first.
- Route to core; every change logged; `python manage.py check` before done.
- No AI attribution anywhere.
- The running Cairn uses this folder: work in a git worktree, and never restart it without the owner's go (it closes every Claude).

tasks.title: What happens outside Cairn shows up in Cairn, live
tasks.description_md: Owner request (2026-11-23). The owner keeps working as before: by hand in an editor, or with Claude Code in their own terminal. When the folder is a project's (Flowintel, for example), Cairn follows: commits, branches, files not committed, pull requests, Claude sessions and what they do, instances.
tasks.acceptance_md:
- A commit, a new branch or a pull request made by hand appears in the project without pressing anything
- A Claude Code started in a terminal in a project's folder is attached to that project by itself
- A branch or a commit that names a task moves or proposes to move it
- The day summary is complete in the evening with nothing to do
- Nothing is written in the owner's repositories, and no heavy polling

tasks.title: Claude Code in the owner's terminal keeps Cairn up to date
tasks.description_md: Owner request (2026-11-23), the other direction. A Claude Code launched outside Cairn has Cairn's tools and rules in every project's folder: it reads the plan and, as it works, updates the task, its status, the comments and the follow-ups, so that everything is in Cairn in the evening.
tasks.acceptance_md:
- Set up once for the machine, shown and approved before it touches Claude Code's configuration, undone in one click
- The project is found from the folder; outside a project, nothing is sent
- A reminder at the end of the work if the task was not updated
- Changes logged as that session's, and undoable
- A change made in Cairn (status, order, a note) reaches the Claude in the terminal
